pinyin: xīng qī rì yǒu méi yǒu kè ?

meaning: Grandmother drinks tea with grandfather.

pinyin: wǒ gēn péng you dōu xǐ huān hē chá .
meaning: My friend and I both like tea.

text: 下午去看朋友，还是在家读书？
pinyin: xià wǔ qù kàn péng you , hái shi zài jiā dú shū ?
meaning: Visit friends in the afternoon, or read at home?

text: 这个颜色真好看，太好看了！
pinyin: zhè gè yán sè zhēn hǎo kàn , tài hǎo kàn le !
meaning: This colour looks really good—so good!

pinyin: zhè sān jiàn , bái sè de zuì hǎo kàn .
meaning: Of these three, the white one looks best.

pinyin: yī fú hái méi gān , xiàn zài bù lěng .
meaning: The clothes are not dry yet; it is not cold now.

pinyin: tài wǎn le ! míng tiān zài kàn ba .
meaning: It is too late! Let us look again tomorrow.

pinyin: zuò chē bǐ zǒu lù kuài .
meaning: Taking a vehicle is faster than walking.

pinyin: shāng chǎng méi yǒu tú shū guǎn ān jìng .
meaning: The shopping centre is not as quiet as the library.

text: 我们一起走，也一块儿聊天。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu , yě yī kuàir liáo tiān .
meaning: We walk together and chat together.

text: 我想散步，也想听你说话。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng sàn bù , yě xiǎng tīng nǐ shuō huà .
meaning: I want to take a walk and also hear you speak.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào le .
meaning: I know now; understood.

pinyin: nǐ míng tiān huí jiā ma ?
meaning: Are you going home tomorrow?

pinyin: wǒ dú shū ne .
meaning: I am reading.

pinyin: jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ?
meaning: What time is the exam?

pinyin: shàng wǔ hái shi xià wǔ kǎo shì ?
meaning: Is the exam in the morning or afternoon?

pinyin: míng tiān kǎo bù kǎo ?
meaning: Is there a test tomorrow or not?

pinyin: nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?
meaning: Did you buy it online?

text: 楼前、楼后，门左边、门右边。
pinyin: lóu qián , lóu hòu , mén zuǒ biān , mén yòu biān .
meaning: In front of and behind the building; to the left and right of the gate.

text: 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边。
pinyin: shàng biān , xià biān , lǐ bian , wài biān , qián biān , hòu biān .
meaning: Above, below, inside, outside, in front, behind.

text: 左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边。
pinyin: zuǒ biān , yòu biān , dōng biān , nán biān , xī biān , běi biān .
meaning: Left, right, east, south, west, north.

text: 面向北，右边是东，左边是西。
pinyin: miàn xiàng běi , yòu biān shì dōng , zuǒ biān shì xī .
meaning: Facing north, east is on the right and west on the left.

pinyin: jǐ gè rén ? liǎng gè rén .
meaning: How many people? Two.

pinyin: rù kǒu . chū kǒu . hǎo !
meaning: Entrance. Exit. Okay!

pinyin: lín jū hěn rè qíng , bēi zi huài le .
meaning: The neighbours are welcoming; the cup is broken.

text: 我不是工人，昨天没去学校。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gōng rén , zuó tiān méi qù xué xiào .
meaning: I am not a worker; I did not go to school yesterday.

pinyin: tā shì yī gè rè qíng de rén .
meaning: She is a welcoming person.

text: 门外是一棵树，前边是学校。
pinyin: mén wài shì yī kē shù , qián biān shì xué xiào .
meaning: Outside the door is a tree; ahead is the school.

text: 两本书在桌上，它们是我的。
pinyin: liǎng běn shū zài zhuō shàng , tā men shì wǒ de .
meaning: The two books are on the table; they are mine.

text: 咱一起读吧。咱们都参加，你也来。
pinyin: zán yì qǐ dú ba . zán men dōu cān jiā , nǐ yě lái .
meaning: Let us read together. All of us, including you, will participate.

text: 年轻的老师很热情，大家参加活动。
pinyin: nián qīng de lǎo shī hěn rè qíng , dà jiā cān jiā huó dòng .
meaning: The young teacher is welcoming; everyone joins the activity.

text: 这篇文章，我读懂了。大家热情，是我的看法。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng , wǒ dú dǒng le . dà jiā rè qíng , shì wǒ de kàn fa .
meaning: I have read and understood this passage. “Everyone is welcoming” is my impression.

text: 我会说一点普通话。明天可能下雨，也可能不下。
pinyin: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn pǔ tōng huà . míng tiān kě néng xià yǔ , yě kě néng bù xià .
meaning: I can speak a little Mandarin. It may rain tomorrow, or it may not.

text: 我该不该带食物？主人说不用带。
pinyin: wǒ gāi bù gāi dài shí wù ? zhǔ ren shuō bù yòng dài .
meaning: Should I bring food? The host said there was no need.

text: 不应该随便猜，先问清楚。
pinyin: bù yīng gāi suí biàn cāi , xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
meaning: We should not guess casually; ask clearly first.

text: 我带两瓶水，可以吗？行吗？可以。
pinyin: wǒ dài liǎng píng shuǐ , kě yǐ ma ? xíng ma ? kě yǐ .
meaning: May I bring two bottles of water? Is that okay? Yes.

text: 带这本书怎么样？合适，她喜欢读书。
pinyin: dài zhè běn shū zěn me yàng ? hé shì , tā xǐ huān dú shū .
meaning: How about bringing this book? Suitable; she likes reading.

text: 你愿意不愿意星期六来？愿意，但时间还要商量。
pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì bù yuàn yì xīng qī liù lái ? yuàn yì , dàn shí jiān hái yào shāng liang .
meaning: Are you willing to come on Saturday? Yes, but we still need to discuss the time.

text: 你星期五还是星期六方便？星期六。还是星期六吧。
pinyin: nǐ xīng qī wǔ hái shi xīng qī liù fāng biàn ? xīng qī liù . hái shi xīng qī liù ba .
meaning: Is Friday or Saturday convenient? Saturday. Let us choose Saturday, then.

text: 为什么选这里？这里安静。味道怎么样？不错。
pinyin: wèi shén me xuǎn zhè lǐ ? zhè lǐ ān jìng . wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bù cuò .
meaning: Why choose here? It is quiet. How does it taste? Good.

text: 怎样去？坐车到大学站，再走五分钟。
pinyin: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē dào dà xué zhàn , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: How do we get there? Ride to University Station, then walk five minutes.

text: 为什么不叫外卖？想出去走走。这里服务怎么样？很热情。
pinyin: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu . zhè lǐ fú wù zěn me yàng ? hěn rè qíng .
meaning: Why not order delivery? I want a walk. How is the service here? Welcoming.

text: 你认为怎样去合适？坐车吧。
pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi zěn yàng qù hé shì ? zuò chē ba .
meaning: What way of getting there do you think is suitable? Let us take a vehicle.

text: 我看了看题目，才发现第二题没做。
pinyin: wǒ kàn le kàn tí mù , cái fā xiàn dì èr tí méi zuò .
meaning: I briefly looked at the questions and only then noticed I had not done the second.

text: 我们练习练习这段对话吧。
pinyin: wǒ men liàn xí liàn xí zhè duàn duì huà ba .
meaning: Let us practise this dialogue a little.

text: 看一场电影，去一回活动，检查两次答案。
pinyin: kàn yī chǎng diàn yǐng , qù yī huí huó dòng , jiǎn chá liǎng cì dá àn .
meaning: Watch one film showing, attend an activity once, check the answers twice.

text: 老师拍三下手，然后大家看一下题目。
pinyin: lǎo shī pāi sān xià shǒu , rán hòu dà jiā kàn yī xià tí mù .
meaning: The teacher claps three times, then everyone looks briefly at the questions.

pinyin: wǒ jiǎn chá le sān cì dá àn .
meaning: I checked the answers three times.

text: 录音听了两遍，句子读了三次。
pinyin: lù yīn tīng le liǎng biàn , jù zi dú le sān cì .
meaning: The recording was heard twice through and the sentence read three times.

text: 昨天没那么冷，今天冷多了。
pinyin: zuó tiān méi nà me lěng , jīn tiān lěng duō le .
meaning: Yesterday was not that cold; today is much colder.

text: 我们这样做，别像昨天那样猜。
pinyin: wǒ men zhè yàng zuò , bié xiàng zuó tiān nà yàng cāi .
meaning: Let us do it this way, rather than guess like yesterday.

text: 这封信是朋友写的，那张图片是老师发的。
pinyin: zhè fēng xìn shì péng you xiě de , nà zhāng tú piàn shì lǎo shī fā de .
meaning: This letter was written by a friend; that image was sent by the teacher.

text: 我去问主办方，再发短信告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ qù wèn zhǔ bàn fāng , zài fā duǎn xìn gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I will ask the organizer, then text you.

text: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
pinyin: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
meaning: We go happily to meet our friends.

text: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
meaning: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

pinyin: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
meaning: That green one is relatively light.

text: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié yòu zhòng yòu guì , wǒ jīn tiān bù chuān .
meaning: These shoes are both heavy and expensive; I will not wear them today.

text: 这个样子又可爱又自然。
pinyin: zhè gè yàng zi yòu kě ài yòu zì rán .
meaning: This look is both cute and natural.

pinyin: liǎng wàn shì èr shí gè yī qiān .
meaning: Twenty thousand is twenty thousands.

text: 一亿是一万万，不是一百万。
pinyin: yī yì shì yī wàn wàn , bù shì yī bǎi wàn .
meaning: One hundred million is ten thousand ten-thousands, not one million.

text: 活动一个多小时，不是十多个小时。
pinyin: huó dòng yī gè duō xiǎo shí , bù shì shí duō gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: The activity lasts a little over an hour, not more than ten hours.

text: 水果三斤多，钱一百多块，先问具体是多少。
pinyin: shuǐ guǒ sān jīn duō , qián yī bǎi duō kuài , xiān wèn jù tǐ shì duō shao .
meaning: The fruit is a little over three jin and the cost over a hundred yuan; ask for exact amounts.

text: 一封信，一件衣服，一条围巾。
pinyin: yī fēng xìn , yī jiàn yī fú , yī tiáo wéi jīn .
meaning: A letter, an item of clothing, a scarf.

pinyin: zhè wèi lǎo shī shōu dào liǎng fēng xìn .
meaning: This teacher received two letters.

text: 我给她一支笔，包裹送到学校。
pinyin: wǒ gěi tā yī zhī bǐ , bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào .
meaning: I give her a pen; the parcel is delivered to the school.

text: 他学了两年汉语，在这里住三天。
pinyin: tā xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ , zài zhè lǐ zhù sān tiān .
meaning: He has studied Chinese for two years and stays here for three days.

text: 一周以后再见，下周还有节目。
pinyin: yī zhōu yǐ hòu zài jiàn , xià zhōu hái yǒu jié mù .
meaning: See you a week later; there is another programme next week.

text: 开场以前先坐好，散场以后再出去。
pinyin: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān zuò hǎo , sàn chǎng yǐ hòu zài chū qù .
meaning: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看有没有车。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: Have tea after the show; check transport before going home.

text: 快要七点了，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: It is nearly seven; the programme is about to begin.

text: 下周就要放假了，不是已经放假了。
pinyin: xià zhōu jiù yào fàng jià le , bù shì yǐ jīng fàng jià le .
meaning: The holiday starts next week; it has not already begun.

text: 这里更安静，十分舒服，特别适合读书，挺好的。
pinyin: zhè lǐ gèng ān jìng , shí fēn shū fú , tè bié shì hé dú shū , tǐng hǎo de .
meaning: It is quieter here, very comfortable, especially suitable for reading, and quite good.

text: 门口有一点儿吵，请把音量调小一点儿。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr chǎo , qǐng bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yì diǎn ér .
meaning: It is a little noisy at the entrance; please turn the volume down a little.

text: 里面比门口更安静，也比楼上还安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng , yě bǐ lóu shàng hái ān jìng .
meaning: Inside is quieter than the entrance and even quieter than upstairs.

text: 门口不如里面安静，楼上有里面这么安静吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , lóu shàng yǒu lǐ miàn zhè me ān jìng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is not as quiet as inside; is upstairs as quiet as inside?

text: 我只喝水，只有一个人喝茶。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ hē shuǐ , zhǐ yǒu yī gè rén hē chá .
meaning: I drink only water; only one person drinks tea.

text: 大多数人吃米饭，不能说所有人都吃米饭。
pinyin: dà duō shù rén chī mǐ fàn , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu chī mǐ fàn .
meaning: Most people eat rice; that does not mean everyone does.

text: 两份米饭和一份鱼，先确认配料。
pinyin: liǎng fèn mǐ fàn hé yī fèn yú , xiān què rèn pèi liào .
meaning: Two portions of rice and one fish dish: confirm the ingredients first.

text: 我的那份米饭不要油，清淡的菜先上。
pinyin: wǒ de nà fèn mǐ fàn bú yào yóu , qīng dàn de cài xiān shàng .
meaning: Do not add oil to my rice portion; serve the lightly seasoned dishes first.

text: 我一直在站台等，车忽然停了。
pinyin: wǒ yì zhí zài zhàn tái děng , chē hū rán tíng le .
meaning: I have been waiting at the stop all along; the vehicle suddenly stopped.

text: 都七点了，他七点才到，大家已经等了一会儿。
pinyin: dōu qī diǎn le , tā qī diǎn cái dào , dà jiā yǐ jīng děng le yī huì er .
meaning: It is already seven; he did not arrive until seven and everyone has already waited a while.

text: 今天就三个人，三个座位正好。
pinyin: jīn tiān jiù sān gè rén , sān gè zuò wèi zhèng hǎo .
meaning: Today there are only three people; three seats are exactly enough.

pinyin: tiān wǎn le , gāi huí jiā le .
meaning: It is late; it is time to go home.

text: 该发消息了，还没有发出去。
pinyin: gāi fā xiāo xī le , hái méi yǒu fā chū qù .
meaning: It is time to send the message; it has not gone through yet.

text: 我又走错了，明天再看新地址。
pinyin: wǒ yòu zǒu cuò le , míng tiān zài kàn xīn dì zhǐ .
meaning: I went the wrong way again; tomorrow I will check the new address again.

text: 你老看旧图片，老是走错入口。
pinyin: nǐ lǎo kàn jiù tú piàn , lǎo shì zǒu cuò rù kǒu .
meaning: You keep looking at the old image and repeatedly take the wrong entrance.

text: 先看地址，再出门，然后确认入口。
pinyin: xiān kàn dì zhǐ , zài chū mén , rán hòu què rèn rù kǒu .
meaning: Check the address first, then go out, then confirm the entrance.

text: 先还书，接着借书，接下来交作业。
pinyin: xiān huán shū , jiē zhe jiè shū , jiē xià lái jiāo zuò yè .
meaning: Return books, then borrow books, then hand in homework.

text: 手机一开机，就能看到新消息。
pinyin: shǒu jī yī kāi jī , jiù néng kàn dào xīn xiāo xī .
meaning: New messages can be seen as soon as the phone is switched on.

text: 一确认入口，我们就进去。
pinyin: yī què rèn rù kǒu , wǒ men jiù jìn qù .
meaning: We will go in as soon as the entrance is confirmed.

text: 入口就在东边，不在北门。
pinyin: rù kǒu jiù zài dōng biān , bù zài běi mén .
meaning: The entrance is right on the east side, not at the north gate.

text: 我就想确认时间，没有别的要求。
pinyin: wǒ jiù xiǎng què rèn shí jiān , méi yǒu bié de yāo qiú .
meaning: I only want to confirm the time; I have no other request.

text: 我明白，你提的就是时间问题。
pinyin: wǒ míng bái , nǐ tí de jiù shì shí jiān wèn tí .
meaning: I understand: the issue you raised is precisely the time.

text: 对，我明白你的意思，但还没同意这个安排。
pinyin: duì , wǒ míng bái nǐ de yì si , dàn hái méi tóng yì zhè gè ān pái .
meaning: Yes, I understand what you mean, but I have not agreed to the arrangement yet.

pinyin: tā gù yì bù huí xiāo xī .
meaning: He deliberately does not reply to the messages.

text: 他不是故意不回，手机没信号。
pinyin: tā bù shì gù yì bù huí , shǒu jī méi xìn hào .
meaning: His failure to reply is not deliberate; his phone has no signal.

text: 你不太喜欢这个话题吧？
pinyin: nǐ bù tài xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí ba ?
meaning: You do not really like this topic, do you?

pinyin: bù shì , wǒ shì rèn zhēn de .
meaning: No, I am serious.

text: 他点头是不是表示同意？
pinyin: tā diǎn tóu shì bú shì biǎo shì tóng yì ?
meaning: Does his nod mean agreement?

text: 你不喜欢这个话题，是不是？
pinyin: nǐ bù xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí , shì bú shì ?
meaning: You do not like this topic, is that right?

text: 两条路差不多远，好像都能走。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo lù chà bu duō yuǎn , hǎo xiàng dōu néng zǒu .
meaning: The two routes are about equally far; it looks as though both are usable.

text: 也许下雨，时间一确认，我一定告诉你。
pinyin: yě xǔ xià yǔ , shí jiān yī què rèn , wǒ yí dìng gào sù nǐ .
meaning: It may rain; once the time is confirmed, I will definitely tell you.

pinyin: xià yǔ de huà , jiù huàn dào fàn guǎn .
meaning: If it rains, change to the restaurant.

text: 天晴就在公园见，时间不变。
pinyin: tiān qíng jiù zài gōng yuán jiàn , shí jiān bù biàn .
meaning: If it is clear, meet at the park; the time stays the same.

text: 只要场地开着，我们就按计划见。
pinyin: zhǐ yào chǎng dì kāi zhe , wǒ men jiù àn jì huà jiàn .
meaning: As long as the venue is open, we will meet according to plan.

text: 只要先发消息，就不用一直等。

text: 星期六我休假，也许方便。但假期的计划还没定。

text: 那先商量，不一定现在就定。你有什么意见？

text: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。

text: 行，我改变计划，先问你星期六几点方便。

text: 现在还不知道，明天告诉你，可以吗？

text: 可以，放心。今晚先休息，明天再定。
pinyin: kě yǐ , fàng xīn . jīn wǎn xiān xiū xī , míng tiān zài dìng .

text: 我请求换一天，说还是星期六见吧。这是我的想法，不是已经定好的时间。

text: 朋友有点难过，但相信我不是不愿意。她说星期六休假，也许方便。

text: 假期的计划还没定，我也不一定知道几点方便。我们先商量，听对方的意见。

text: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。她改变了原来的计划。

text: 她让我放心：今晚不来，没有关系；明天告诉她，再改时间。

text: 我没有说一定星期六六点见。我们答应明天再定，不能把一个想法当成最后的计划。

text: 你的看法是什么？这家怎么样？
pinyin: nǐ de kàn fa shì shén me ? zhè jiā zěn me yàng ?

text: 我认为合适。饭馆不大，桌子和碗很干净，服务也热情。

meaning: I think it is suitable. The restaurant is small, its tables and bowls are clean, and the service is welcoming.

text: 味道怎么样？比如这个鸡蛋辣吗？

text: 不辣。我们的口味不同，可以点不同的菜。

text: 好处是离家近，坏处是要等二十分钟。我对菜满意，对等很久有点不满。

pinyin: zěn yàng qù ? shén me shí hou chū fā ?

text: 我带了银行卡和现金，卡能不能用，还要问店里。

text: 一千、一万、一亿是练习读数字，不是今天的费用。要买的东西不少，但没有花一万。

text: 我先把包裹放下，拿纸和笔写地址，再检查收件人。
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ bāo guǒ fàng xià , ná zhǐ hé bǐ xiě dì zhǐ , zài jiǎn chá shōu jiàn rén .
meaning: I put the parcel down, take paper and a pen to write the address, and then check the recipient.

text: 接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。
pinyin: jiē dào fú wù tái de tōng zhī hòu , lǎo shī kě yǐ qù ná . wǒ qǐng péng you bǎ lìng yī fēng xìn jiāo gěi tā .
meaning: After receiving the service desk’s notice, the teacher can collect it. I ask my friend to hand her the other letter.

text: 别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。
pinyin: bié ren bù fāng biàn jiē shòu lǐ wù , yě kě yǐ shuō bù yòng le . gǎn xiè bù yí dìng yào kào sòng dōng xi .
meaning: Someone who finds accepting a gift inconvenient can decline it. Gratitude does not have to depend on giving things.

text: 我写了两封信，一封给朋友，一封给老师。朋友前几天照顾我，我想感谢她。她看了信，说很感动。我送给她一条围巾。那件衣服不是礼物，留给我自己。给老师的礼物是一套笔记本和笔，每人一份，不用猜价格。朋友住三层，但这个包裹要送到学校。学校地址在我的笔记里。我先把包裹放下，拿纸和笔写地址，再检查收件人。接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。

meaning: I wrote two letters, one to my friend and one to my teacher. My friend looked after me a few days ago, and I wanted to thank her. She read the letter and said she was moved. I give her a scarf. The item of clothing is not a gift; I keep it for myself. The teacher’s gift is a set of notebooks and pens: one gift each, with no need to guess the price. My friend lives on the third floor, but this parcel goes to the school. The school address is in my notes. text: 地址写好了，就交给快递吧。
pinyin: dì zhǐ xiě hǎo le , jiù jiāo gěi kuài dì ba .
meaning: The address is written; let us give it to the delivery service.

text: 等一下，这张纸上只有学校，没有收件人的名字。
pinyin: děng yī xià , zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng zhǐ yǒu xué xiào , méi yǒu shōu jiàn rén de míng zi .
meaning: Wait: this sheet has only the school name, not the recipient’s name.

text: 我刚才只看三层，忘了补写。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn sān céng , wàng le bǔ xiě .
meaning: I only checked the third floor and forgot to add it.

text: 楼层不是名字。是送给老师的那一份吗？
pinyin: lóu céng bù shì míng zi . shì sòng gěi lǎo shī de nà yī fèn ma ?
meaning: The floor is not a name. Is this the gift for the teacher?

text: 对。写上名字，再检查一遍。
pinyin: duì . xiě shàng míng zi , zài jiǎn chá yī biàn .
meaning: Yes. Add the name and check once more.

text: 这样才清楚。谢谢你照顾我的包裹。
pinyin: zhè yàng cái qīng chǔ . xiè xiè nǐ zhào gù wǒ de bāo guǒ .
meaning: Now it is clear. Thank you for looking after my parcel.

text: 你刚到吗？我早晨看了通知，说六点半集合。
pinyin: nǐ gāng dào ma ? wǒ zǎo chén kàn le tōng zhī , shuō liù diǎn bàn jí hé .
meaning: Did you just arrive? I read a notice this morning saying to meet at half past six.

text: 先停一下。新通知刚刚发来，集合改成六点四十。
pinyin: xiān tíng yī xià . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái , jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí .
meaning: Wait. The new notice has just arrived; the meeting time changed to six forty.

pinyin: jié mù yě gǎi le ma ?
meaning: Did the programme time change too?

text: 没有，还是七点。开场以前先检票，六点四十集合就好。
pinyin: méi yǒu , hái shi qī diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , liù diǎn sì shí jí hé jiù hǎo .
meaning: No, still seven. Tickets are checked before the start; meeting at six forty is fine.

text: 那我们有二十分钟。刚才收到的是什么？
pinyin: nà wǒ men yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng . gāng cái shōu dào de shì shén me ?
meaning: Then we have twenty minutes. What did we receive just now?

text: 刚才是旧的。上周的图片也别当成今天的。
pinyin: gāng cái shì jiù de . shàng zhōu de tú piàn yě bié dàng chéng jīn tiān de .
meaning: That was the old one. Do not treat last week’s image as today’s either.

text: 这时灯还亮着，节目还没开始吧？
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe , jié mù hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
meaning: The lights are still on now; it has not started yet, right?

text: 对，快要七点了。灯暗了以后先别走，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: duì , kuài yào qī diǎn le . dēng àn le yǐ hòu xiān bié zǒu , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: Right, nearly seven. Stay seated after the lights dim; the programme is about to begin.

text: 散场后喝茶？夜里还有车吗？
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá ? yè lǐ hái yǒu chē ma ?
meaning: Tea after the show? Will transport still be running at night?

text: 先确认，别到半夜才问。不一会儿，另一位朋友也会到。
pinyin: xiān què rèn , bié dào bàn yè cái wèn . bù yí huìr , lìng yī wèi péng you yě huì dào .
meaning: Check first; do not wait until midnight to ask. Another friend will arrive shortly too.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期节目不少。下周还有？
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī jié mù bù shǎo . xià zhōu hái yǒu ?
meaning: It is the school’s tenth anniversary; quite a few programmes this term. Another next week?

text: 有，不久以后再发通知。今天先看这一场。
pinyin: yǒu , bù jiǔ yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī . jīn tiān xiān kàn zhè yī chǎng .
meaning: Yes, another notice will be sent before long. Today let us watch this one first.

pinyin: gāng cái shōu dào de tú piàn shì jiù de . hòu lái wǒ men cái kàn dào xīn xiāo xī , xiān tíng xià lái jiǎn chá le yī biàn .
meaning: The image received just now was old. We only saw the new message afterwards and stopped to check it.

text: 从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。
pinyin: cóng liù diǎn sì shí dào qī diǎn yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , bù shì èr shí diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , zài rù chǎng .
meaning: There are twenty minutes from six forty to seven, not twenty o’clock. Have tickets checked before the start, then enter.

text: 这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe . kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù yào kāi shǐ le , dàn hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The lights are still on now. It is nearly seven and the programme is about to begin, but it has not started yet.

text: 灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
pinyin: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

text: 不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
pinyin: bù yí huìr , péng you yě lái le . wǒ men méi yǒu děng dào bàn yè cái wèn huí jiā de bàn fǎ .
meaning: Our friend arrived in a little while too. We did not wait until the middle of the night to ask how to get home.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng . shàng zhōu qù guò yī cì , xià zhōu hái xiǎng zài qù .
meaning: For the school’s tenth anniversary there is an activity every week this term. We went once last week and want to go again next week.

text: 不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。
pinyin: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu huì fā xià zhōu de tōng zhī . jīn tiān zhè yī zhāng bù néng ná lái què dìng xià zhōu de shí jiān .
meaning: Next week’s notice will be sent before long. Today’s notice cannot establish next week’s times.

text: 刚到门口，先停一停。旧图放下，新消息看清。

meaning: Just at the door, pause a moment. Put down the old image; read the new message clearly.

text: 六点四十，一起集合。二十分钟以后，七点开场。
pinyin: liù diǎn sì shí , yì qǐ jí hé . èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , qī diǎn kāi chǎng .
meaning: Meet together at six forty. Twenty minutes later, start at seven.

text: 开场前检票，灯暗后坐好。要开始了，不是已经散场。
pinyin: kāi chǎng qián jiǎn piào , dēng àn hòu zuò hǎo . yào kāi shǐ le , bù shì yǐ jīng sàn chǎng .
meaning: Check tickets before the start; sit when the lights dim. About to begin does not mean already ended.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看车。不等半夜，才想办法。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn chē . bù děng bàn yè , cái xiǎng bàn fǎ .
meaning: Tea after the show; check transport before heading home. Do not leave planning until midnight.

text: 上周是上周，下周等通知。今天的时间，别送给明天。
pinyin: shàng zhōu shì shàng zhōu , xià zhōu děng tōng zhī . jīn tiān de shí jiān , bié sòng gěi míng tiān .
meaning: Last week is last week; wait for next week’s notice. Do not give today’s times to tomorrow.

text: 一周又一周，朋友还会见。周年有节目，我们慢慢看。
pinyin: yī zhōu yòu yī zhōu , péng you hái huì jiàn . zhōu nián yǒu jié mù , wǒ men màn màn kàn .
meaning: Week after week, we will meet friends again. Anniversary programmes: we can take our time watching.

text: 里面好多座位，没满。这里比门口更安静。

text: 后面没有这么亮，也离音箱更远。
pinyin: hòu miàn méi yǒu zhè me liàng , yě lí yīn xiāng gèng yuǎn .
meaning: It is not this bright farther back, and it is farther from the speaker.

text: 好，那边读书的人不少，我们小声说。
pinyin: hǎo , nà biān dú shū de rén bù shǎo , wǒ men xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Good. Quite a few people are reading there; let us speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十，贵十块。费用不超过五十，行吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí , guì shí kuài . fèi yòng bù chāo guò wǔ shí , xíng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is forty and inside fifty, ten more. At most fifty, okay?

text: 行。门口不如里面安静，十块是差价，不是全部。

text: 两边温度不同，里面比门口低三度。

text: 但我没量声音，不能说低了多少分贝。只觉得这里更合适。

text: 音箱的声音有点儿难听，要不要再大声说？

text: 电话没通，我先发短信。一到东边就发消息，确认后再进入。

text: 入口和出口不同。出口在右边，入口要看新的通知。

text: 进入后拿出要还的书，先还书，然后借书，接着交作业。

我站在门边，没有坐在座位上。
先站在门外，等朋友出来。
听到朋友叫我，我先站住。
请站住，前面还不能进去。
我们说这件事情，不是说你不好。
事情还没说清楚，先别下结论。
这个建议受到重视，但还没有实行。
我受到朋友的帮助，也想帮别人。
答应以后要有行动。
占座位是这里讨论的行为。
这种行为让别人等了很久，要解释原因。
改了时间以后，活动进行得很顺利。
今天报名很顺利，不到五分钟就好了。
门口不能放包，要让路安全。
这个安排挺好，但还要确认地方。
这个办法挺好，不过还要问朋友愿不愿意。
我们能够换到外面聊。

pinyin: wǒ zhè cì shuō de zěn me yàng ?
meaning: How did I speak this time?

text: 第一句很清楚，第二句的数字没听清。
pinyin: dì yī jù hěn qīng chǔ , dì èr jù de shù zì méi tīng qīng .
meaning: The first sentence was clear; I did not hear the numbers in the second clearly.

pinyin: nà wǒ bǎ quán bù chóng fù yī biàn ?
meaning: Then should I repeat everything?

text: 不用，只重复第二句，说得更慢一点。
pinyin: bù yòng , zhǐ chóng fù dì èr jù , shuō de gèng màn yī diǎn .
meaning: No need; repeat only the second sentence, a little more slowly.

pinyin: wǒ yī gòng huā le sān shí wǔ kuài .
meaning: I spent thirty-five yuan in total.

text: 这次听清了，是三十五，不是五十三。
pinyin: zhè cì tīng qīng le , shì sān shí wǔ , bù shì wǔ shí sān .
meaning: Now I heard it clearly: thirty-five, not fifty-three.

text: 那我已经有高级水平了吗？
pinyin: nà wǒ yǐ jīng yǒu gāo jí shuǐ píng le ma ?
meaning: Then do I already have advanced ability?

text: 一句话不能证明全部水平。这个地方进步了，继续练。
pinyin: yī jù huà bù néng zhèng míng quán bù shuǐ píng . zhè gè dì fāng jìn bù le , jì xù liàn .
meaning: One sentence cannot demonstrate overall ability. This part improved; keep practising.

text: 我这次说得怎么样？第一句很清楚，第二句的数字没听清。那我把全部重复一遍？不用，只重复第二句，说得更慢一点。我一共花了三十五块。这次听清了，是三十五，不是五十三。那我已经有高级水平了吗？一句话不能证明全部水平。这个地方进步了，继续练。

text: 课堂上黑板写着两句话，先听再说。
pinyin: kè táng shàng hēi bǎn xiě zhe liǎng jù huà , xiān tīng zài shuō .
meaning: In class, two sentences are on the blackboard; listen before speaking.

text: 第一句说得清楚，第二句的数字要重复。
pinyin: dì yī jù shuō de qīng chǔ , dì èr jù de shù zì yào chóng fù .
meaning: The first sentence is clear; the numbers in the second need repeating.

text: 第二次说三十五块，朋友听清了。
pinyin: dì èr cì shuō sān shí wǔ kuài , péng you tīng qīng le .
meaning: The second attempt says thirty-five yuan, and the friend hears it clearly.

text: 表里记录两次，不记录正式等级。
pinyin: biǎo lǐ jì lù liǎng cì , bù jì lù zhèng shì děng jí .
meaning: The table records two attempts, not an official level.

text: 有信心也要努力练习，查清楚问题。
pinyin: yǒu xìn xīn yě yào nǔ lì liàn xí , chá qīng chǔ wèn tí .
meaning: Confidence still goes with practice and clarifying the problem.

text: 一篇长作文可以分开练，不必一次说完。
pinyin: yī piān cháng zuò wén kě yǐ fēn kāi liàn , bù bì yī cì shuō wán .
meaning: A long composition can be practised in parts; there is no need to say it all at once.

text: 今天两节课，气温三度，两个数字的用途不同。
pinyin: jīn tiān liǎng jié kè , qì wēn sān dù , liǎng gè shù zì de yòng tú bù tóng .
meaning: Two lessons today and a temperature of three degrees: the numbers serve different purposes.

text: 提高来自具体改进；读得慢，也能读懂。
pinyin: tí gāo lái zì jù tǐ gǎi jìn ; dú de màn , yě néng dú dǒng .
meaning: Improvement comes from specific changes; you can understand while reading slowly.

text: 她在读中级课本，还是会问生词。
pinyin: tā zài dú zhōng jí kè běn , hái shi huì wèn shēng cí .
meaning: She is using an intermediate textbook and still asks about unfamiliar words.

pinyin: nǐ qù guo nà gè bó wù guǎn ma ?
meaning: Have you been to that museum?

text: 去过，前年出国的时候参观过。
pinyin: qù guo , qián nián chū guó de shí hou cān guān guo .
meaning: Yes; I visited it when I went abroad the year before last.

pinyin: nà xīng qī liù yí dìng kāi mén ba ?
meaning: Then it must be open on Saturday, right?

text: 不一定。过去的经历不是今天的通知。
pinyin: bù yí dìng . guò qu de jīng lì bù shì jīn tiān de tōng zhī .
meaning: Not necessarily. Past experience is not today’s notice.

text: 这次国际活动的会几点开始？
pinyin: zhè cì guó jì huó dòng de huì jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
meaning: What time does the meeting for this international event start?

text: 会是两点，旅行日期还没确认。
pinyin: huì shì liǎng diǎn , lǚ xíng rì qī hái méi què rèn .
meaning: The meeting is at two; the trip date is not yet confirmed.

text: 我没坐过船，可以直接选船吗？
pinyin: wǒ méi zuò guo chuán , kě yǐ zhí jiē xuǎn chuán ma ?
meaning: I have never taken a boat; can I just choose it?

text: 先看行程和发船时间，再选择。
pinyin: xiān kàn xíng chéng hé fā chuán shí jiān , zài xuǎn zé .
meaning: Check the itinerary and boat departure time first, then choose.

text: 前年我出国学习，也参观过博物馆。
pinyin: qián nián wǒ chū guó xué xí , yě cān guān guo bó wù guǎn .
meaning: The year before last, I went abroad to study and visited a museum.

text: 去年回国以后，我在家继续学习。
pinyin: qù nián huí guó yǐ hòu , wǒ zài jiā jì xù xué xí .
meaning: After returning to my country last year, I continued studying at home.

text: 我坐过船，也骑过自行车。
pinyin: wǒ zuò guo chuán , yě qí guo zì xíng chē .
meaning: I have taken a boat and ridden a bicycle.

text: 没有看过那里的鱼，也没有爬过那座山。
pinyin: méi yǒu kàn guo nà lǐ de yú , yě méi yǒu pá guo nà zuò shān .
meaning: I have not seen the fish there or climbed that mountain.

text: 这些是经历，不是这次旅行的安排。
pinyin: zhè xiē shì jīng lì , bù shì zhè cì lǚ xíng de ān pái .
meaning: These are experiences, not arrangements for this trip.

text: 护照用于旅行，证件要求需要看正式通知。
pinyin: hù zhào yòng yú lǚ xíng , zhèng jiàn yāo qiú xū yào kàn zhèng shì tōng zhī .
meaning: A passport is used for travel; document requirements must be checked in the formal notice.

text: 游客和旅客都要确认时间，不能只看以前的照片。
pinyin: yóu kè hé lǚ kè dōu yào què rèn shí jiān , bù néng zhǐ kàn yǐ qián de zhào piān .
meaning: Visitors and passengers need to confirm times, rather than rely only on old photos.

text: 外地朋友来看我，我说一路平安，到了再发消息。
pinyin: wài dì péng you lái kàn wǒ , wǒ shuō yí lù píng ān , dào le zài fā xiāo xī .
meaning: A friend comes from out of town to visit; I wish a safe journey and ask for a message after arrival.

text: 我们互相帮忙，不是只让你做。我们互相问清楚时间，不替别人答应。相互尊重，也包括听到拒绝。这个问题想请教你。有不懂的地方，可以向老师请教。先打听时间，不问私人信息。我先打听开门时间，不直接猜。访问前先联系对方。访问以前先约时间，别突然到。她负责接待，不是负责所有安排。改了时间，要及时告诉朋友。她及时回了消息，我还没出发。提前问清楚，不是提前替她答应。要提前问，不等到门口才说。我想约她见面，时间还没定。我们约了明天下午，不是今天。告别前，再确认明天的时间。活动结束时，先向主人告别。朋友结婚了，不等于所有人都参加了婚礼。她朋友结婚了，具体安排还要看邀请。谈话先问她现在方便不方便。谈话没结束，我先不打断。最后补充一句，我只问时间。她们是亲姐妹，不是只看起来像。领导不在，可以先问联系人。领导不在，先问今天谁负责接待。交往要相互尊重，不替别人做决定。交往中有问题，可以先说明自己的需要。
pinyin: wǒ men hù xiāng bāng máng , bù shì zhǐ ràng nǐ zuò . wǒ men hù xiāng wèn qīng chǔ shí jiān , bù tì bié ren dā yìng . xiāng hù zūn zhòng , yě bāo kuò tīng dào jù jué . zhè gè wèn tí xiǎng qǐng jiào nǐ . yǒu bù dǒng de dì fāng , kě yǐ xiàng lǎo shī qǐng jiào . xiān dǎ tīng shí jiān , bù wèn sī rén xìn xī . wǒ xiān dǎ tīng kāi mén shí jiān , bù zhí jiē cāi . fǎng wèn qián xiān lián xì duì fāng . fǎng wèn yǐ qián xiān yuē shí jiān , bié tū rán dào . tā fù zé jiē dài , bù shì fù zé suǒ yǒu ān pái . gǎi le shí jiān , yào jí shí gào sù péng you . tā jí shí huí le xiāo xī , wǒ hái méi chū fā . tí qián wèn qīng chǔ , bù shì tí qián tì tā dā yìng . yào tí qián wèn , bù děng dào mén kǒu cái shuō . wǒ xiǎng yuē tā jiàn miàn , shí jiān hái méi dìng . wǒ men yuē le míng tiān xià wǔ , bù shì jīn tiān . gào bié qián , zài què rèn míng tiān de shí jiān . huó dòng jié shù shí , xiān xiàng zhǔ rén gào bié . péng you jié hūn le , bù děng yú suǒ yǒu rén dōu cān jiā le hūn lǐ . tā péng you jié hūn le , jù tǐ ān pái hái yào kàn yāo qǐng . tán huà xiān wèn tā xiàn zài fāng biàn bù fāng biàn . tán huà méi jié shù , wǒ xiān bù dǎ duàn . zuì hòu bǔ chōng yī jù , wǒ zhǐ wèn shí jiān . tā men shì qīn jiě mèi , bù shì zhǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng . lǐng dǎo bù zài , kě yǐ xiān wèn lián xì rén . lǐng dǎo bù zài , xiān wèn jīn tiān shéi fù zé jiē dài . jiāo wǎng yào xiāng hù zūn zhòng , bù tì bié ren zuò jué dìng . jiāo wǎng zhōng yǒu wèn tí , kě yǐ xiān shuō míng zì jǐ de xū yào .
meaning: We help each other, rather than leave all the work to you. We clarify the time with each other without agreeing for others. Mutual respect includes hearing a refusal. I first inquire about opening time rather than guessing. Contact the other party before a visit or interview. Arrange a time before visiting rather than arriving suddenly. She handles reception, not every arrangement. Tell friends promptly if the time changes. She replied promptly, before I had set off. Ask clearly beforehand, rather than agree on her behalf. Add one final detail: I ask only about the time. They are biological sisters, not just similar-looking. The leader is absent; ask the contact person first. The leader is absent; ask who handles reception today. Interaction needs mutual respect; do not decide for others. When problems arise in interactions, first explain one’s needs.

meaning: You put the whole group inside one sheet.

pinyin: nà liù zhāng , liǎng zǔ fēn bié sān zhāng .
meaning: Then six sheets, three for each of two groups.

text: 对，一人一张，张张有名字。
pinyin: duì , yī rén yī zhāng , zhāng zhāng yǒu míng zì .
meaning: Yes, one per person, each with a name.

pinyin: zhǐ qí le , rén hái yào shù .
meaning: The sheets are all here; we still count people.

pinyin: zhè cì quán miàn le yì diǎn ér .

text: 一张一张递，那一共就是一张？你把整个小组放进一张纸了。那六张，两组分别三张。对，一人一张，张张有名字。纸齐了，人还要数。这次全面了一点儿。
pinyin: yī zhāng yī zhāng dì , nà yī gòng jiù shì yī zhāng ? nǐ bǎ zhěng gè xiǎo zǔ fàng jìn yī zhāng zhǐ le . nà liù zhāng , liǎng zǔ fēn bié sān zhāng . duì , yī rén yī zhāng , zhāng zhāng yǒu míng zì . zhǐ qí le , rén hái yào shù . zhè cì quán miàn le yì diǎn ér .
meaning: Pass one at a time, so there is just one in total? You put the whole group inside one sheet. Then six sheets, three for each of two groups. Yes, one per person, each with a name. The sheets are all here; we still count people. A little more comprehensive this time.

text: 今天说得比昨天清楚，但不比你快。
pinyin: jīn tiān shuō dé bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ , dàn bù bǐ nǐ kuài .
meaning: Today I speak more clearly than yesterday, but not faster than you.

text: 不比我快，就是一定比我慢吗？

text: 不是，可能一样快。速度没有具体记录。

meaning: No, possibly equally fast. There is no actual speed record.

pinyin: nǐ dú le jǐ biàn ?

text: 三遍，你两遍，我比你多读一遍。
pinyin: sān biàn , nǐ liǎng biàn , wǒ bǐ nǐ duō dú yī biàn .
meaning: Three; you read twice, so I read once more.

meaning: Today practise original short lines: speak clearly before singing.

text: 三遍比两遍多一遍，只说次数，不说谁更有才能。
pinyin: sān biàn bǐ liǎng biàn duō yī biàn , zhǐ shuō cì shù , bù shuō shéi gèng yǒu cái néng .
meaning: Three repetitions is one more than two; that compares counts, not talent.

text: 说得比昨天清楚是进步方向，没有准确分数。

meaning: Clearer speech than yesterday indicates a direction of progress, not an exact score.

text: 不比朋友快可以一样快，不能自动写成更慢。

meaning: Not faster than a friend may be equally fast; do not automatically report slower.

text: 艺术表演会改变声音，学习声调要听清楚的说话。

text: 舞台也能演话剧，不是所有演员都是歌手。

text: 技术可以进一步改进，乐队没来时也先读文字。
